newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Ent files shelf for $2.5 bln debt.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Ent files shelf for $2.5 bln debt.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $2.5 billion in debt securities, currency warrants and warrants to purchase senior debt securities.
When combined with previous registrations, Coca-Cola will have a total offering of $3,170,575,000 in securities available for sale, the filing said.
Coca-Cola said it intends to use the net proceeds from the sale of the securities for general corporate purposes, including the repayment of debt and possible business acquisitions.
Based in Atlanta, Georgia, the company is the world's largest marketer, distributor and producer of bottled and canned beverage products of the Coca-Cola company.
